args.query: select a.*, s.* from api.application a left join api.status s on s.id=a.status_id limit 0;
select table_name,column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema='api' and table_name in ('application','status','contract','company') order by 1,ordinal_position;

out:
application|id
application|number
application|company_inn
application|status_id
application|amount
application|revenue
application|description
application|expert
application|verdict
company|inn
company|name
company|funding_limit
contract|id
contract|number

args.query: select s.id,s.name,a.number,a.company_inn,c.name,(select count(*) from api.contract k where k.application_id=a.id) n, (select string_agg(k.status,',') from api.contract k where k.application_id=a.id) st from api.application a join api.status s on s.id=a.status_id left join api.company c on c.inn=a.company_inn order by s.ord,a.number;
